messages:
selena: FYI I submitted my resignation today, last day 2027-04-09. Want to make sure benefits/COBRA, final paycheck, and device return are cleanly handled. I'll be available for handoffs this week.

matt: Thanks for flagging. I'll own SSO and repo access. Can you paste laptop serial and any personal SSH/GH keys you know about?

selena: Laptop SN: RW-GB-7788. I have one personal SSH key (home-laptop) and one PAT used for CI. I'll remove personal items.

benefits: Heads-up: benefits active through 2027-04-30 (EOM). People Ops will send COBRA packet 2027-04-12 with opt-in instructions and vendor portal link.

matt: Plan suggestion:
• create offboard ticket (People Ops)
• inventory 3rd-party admin rights (add backups)
• schedule exit interview (HR)
• staged deprovision on last day: disable SSO 09:00, revoke PATs 09:30, remove alerting/oncall 10:00, rotate shared secrets 10:30
• confirm device drop-off or label and MDM unenroll (selena)

it-ops-bot: Created IT-14567 "Selena offboard: access + device + benefits". Assigned to Matt. Initial ETA: 1 business day. :white_check_mark:

selena: I'll drop laptop at reception on last day and join a 30-min handoff. Please keep email available for 24 hours for payroll.

matt: Copy that. I'll run a quick sweep for org admin roles and tokens: `gh api /user/keys` and `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --filter="user:selena@redwood.com"`. Adding results to IT-14567.

hr: Exit interview scheduled for 2027-04-06 14:00. We'll confirm final PTO payout and include COBRA instructions in the packet.

selena: One more: I'm sole owner of a billing contact on one analytics account. I'll add matt.billing and hr.billing today.

matt: Perfect—please confirm by EOD so we don't have any sole-admin cases on the final day. I'll post the final deprovision timeline in the ticket once inventory is complete.

benefits: Reminder: COBRA opt-in window and vendor contact will be in the packet; any questions after receipt, reply to benefits@redwood.com.

selena: Done adding billing contacts. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination.
